rationale: The plan names the correct test for this design: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, with explicit reference levels, Cook's outlier reporting, and an honest n=3 interaction-power caveat, so it is clearly tailored to a 2x4x3 time course rather than generic. QC is design-aware (blind VST, PCA colored by condition and time, sample distances, per-sample library sizes) though the outlier response is limited to flagging rather than a stated inclusion/exclusion policy. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, smallest cell size, before/after counts reported) and normalization (raw counts into median-of-ratios, blind VST kept out of the test) are both minimal and correctly placed. FDR at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering and apeglm/ashr shrinkage of the interaction coefficients is right; the main weakness is ranking fgsea by the unsigned LRT statistic, which is directionally uninformative for a preranked GSEA even though the universe, collection, size window, and fallback behavior are all specified. The final report step covers versions, formulas, thresholds, gene counts, QC findings, and design caveats.
